mentions.name: ConvoLens
mentions.description: This app explores the content of video interviews from YouTube channels by enabling keyword research, RAG-based retrieval, and visualization of discussed topics with a 2D projection and semantic graph. It can also generate a new video or audio from a playlist of video segments. It uses YouTube as its data source, processes content with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and runs locally via Docker Compose.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building ConvoLens [1] - app to explore the content of video interviews from YouTube channels I like (such as Dwarkesh Patel's): research by keyword, RAG, visualization of discussed topics with a 2D projection, semantic graph, and the possibility to generate a new video or audio from a playlist of video segments.
